info.name: TTE Lead Provider API - Test Scenarios
info.description:
Postman collection implementing all test scenarios from the Lead Provider API Test Scenarios document for the Teacher Training Entitlement (TTE) API.

Functional areas:
1. Registration (REG-001 to REG-025)
2. Declarations (DCL-001 to DCL-029)
3. Application Lifecycle (PAR-007 to PAR-017)
4. Participants (PAR-001 to PAR-006)
5. Schedules (SCH-001 to SCH-004)
6. Statements (STM-001 to STM-006)

Setup:
- Set collection variables: `baseUrl`, `apiKey`
- Set application ID variables: `appId001` through `appId012`
- Set statement ID variables: `stmtId001`, `stmtId002`
- IDs for declarations and participants are captured automatically via test scripts.
